text:
Ivy: Heads-up: deploy-bot can't finish canary->prod promote, cut window in 40m.
Ivy: CI jobs failing when restoring cached artifacts. Error looks like symlink creation blocked by mount options on cache hosts.
Sam: Failing log snippet:
```
+ tar -xzf artifacts.tgz
tar: path/to/link -> ../target: Cannot create symlink
ERROR: unpack failed: Operation not permitted
```
ops-jen: Oncall. Confirmed cache hosts were remounted with `no_symlink` flag during maintenance at 11:03 UTC. That explains the failures.
Ivy: Two options: revert mount change across cache fleet (~25m risk) or manual-promote last-green to meet the window. Thoughts?
release-coordinator: Customer-facing notes due in 30m. Prefer manual promote to avoid missing comms. We'll document the pin and infra follow-up.
Sam: deploy-bot shows indexer lease contention too: `lease_acquire_timeout` on artifact-index-04 which prevented an automated fallback.
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt 2 -> blocked: lease_acquire_timeout on artifact-index-04 (retries=5).
ops-jen: Rolling back mount flags across all cache hosts risks restarting processes; not safe during live change window. Manual pin is lower-risk.
Ivy: OK manual promote then. Who can run it and confirm release note wording?
Sam: I'll run the promote and add the release note. Command:
```
/deploy promote --image sha:fb2a9e --env prod --reason "pin-due-to-cache-no_symlink-mount-failure"
```
Sam: Executing manual promote now. /deploy promote --image sha:fb2a9e --env prod --reason "pin-due-to-cache-no_symlink-mount-failure"
deploy-bot: Manual promote requested by Sam. Initiating rollout to prod replicas.
deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 20% -> 60% -> 100%. Health checks OK. Promotion complete. prod image sha:fb2a9e.
release-coordinator: Drafting release note: "Pinned to sha:fb2a9e due to CI artifact extraction failures after cache hosts were remounted with no-symlink option; infra ticket INFRA-2150 opened for mount rollback and postmortem."
ops-jen: INFRA-2150 created, attaching failing job ids bk/7781,bk/7784 and mount diff. Will schedule out-of-band rollback.
Ivy: QA, please run quick smoke suite on uploads and auth flows now that prod is pinned.
Sam: Filing a docs PR to capture the emergency manual-promote commands and checklist for similar cut windows.
Ivy: Closing thread for cut; follow-ups tracked in INFRA-2150 and the docs PR. Thanks all.
__notes: Slack thread as a single continuous string, messages chronological and prefixed with sender name
